messages:
Olivia Chan: Finance flagged a ~12% mismatch between ACME marketplace reported units and our ledger for invoice day 2026-03-18. Can partnerships + eng triage?
Samir Patel: On it. Which batch?
Olivia Chan: ACME batch_id=batch-20260318-2345, they reported ~1.12M units, our aggregator shows ~990k.
Maria Gomez: Pulling their raw webhooks from s3://partners/acme/inbound/2026-03-18. Decompressing now.
usage-ingest-bot: ingest-processor v2.4 processed partner queue 2026-03-18T22:50Z.
Samir Patel: Check seq continuity, dedupe, and timezone normalization.
Maria Gomez: Found seq gaps around 987650-987665; some events have timestamps 2026-03-18T23:59:59-08:00. Our normalization to UTC + batch assignment rounding may have moved events into 03-19 partition.
usage-ingest-bot: query: 14,350 events assigned to 2026-03-19 partition but event_time within 2026-03-18 UTC window.
Samir Patel: That explains ~1.15% of gap.
Maria Gomez: Also found partner metadata change: acme.compute.small units switched seconds->minutes at ~20:02 PST. Our hourly metadata sync likely missed the update until 21:00.
Olivia Chan: That SKU is small slice (~0.4%), so won't explain whole gap.
Ryan Billing: Finance also mentioned we issued credits yesterday to ACME customers 1: could those negative adjustments be included incorrectly?
Samir Patel: Excluding adjustment rows reduces gap by ~3.9%.
Maria Gomez: Still ~6.5% unexplained.
Olivia Chan: Partners-team, ask ACME if they sampled or extrapolated aggregates during the high-ingress window. Also request raw mapping for rotated event_ids.
partners-team: ACME responded: they ran a late resample/extrapolation for spikes starting 03-18T20:00 PST and rotated event_id generator 23:50-23:56. Raw logs link: https://acme.logs/2026-03-18.
Samir Patel: Action plan: 1) Short-term replay of raw webhooks applying current multipliers + robust dedupe to produce corrected counts (owners: Maria + Samir). 2) Medium-term feed contract change: include raw event counts, sampling flag, and event_id mapping when extrapolation occurs (owner: partnerships/legal).
Maria Gomez: Starting staging replay job: copy raw gz -> staging, apply metadata, dedupe using (client_id, original_event_id or payload_hash), reassign partitions. ETA ~3h.
usage-ingest-bot: staging-replay job replay-172800-1 started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/replays/replay-172800-1
Maria Gomez: +1h update: replay finished on staging; corrected delta down to 0.8%. Uploaded sanitized reconcile CSV to finance and ACME.
Olivia Chan: Great. Next steps: partners to negotiate sampling flag + mapping in feed, eng to add hourly metadata sync alert (ENG-5698), billing to hold final invoice until sign-off. Owners set.
Ryan Billing: Finance will wait for final confirm before issuing invoice.
Olivia Chan: I'll draft customer-facing note explaining "extrapolated marketplace totals vs raw webhook counts" and propose contract change. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
